# M3-S1: the __.LOGOS facts sidecar travels beside __.PKGDEF, bound to its
# fingerprint. The sidecar is syntax-agnostic, so this test uses plain
# pointer results; option syntax (*User?) arrives in M3-S2 and only adds
# record kinds (S2-S7) on top of this transport.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A .lgo package importing another .lgo package recovers facts: the module
# builds, links (the linker skips the __.LOGOS member), and runs.
cd lgo
logos build ./...
logos build -o $WORK/lgo-main$GOEXE ./cmd
exec $WORK/lgo-main$GOEXE
stdout '^facts ok: alice$'
cd ..

# A loGo/s compiler archive carries both the export data and the sidecar;
# a plain-Go archive stays byte-identical to upstream and carries none.
go tool compile -p example.com/m/a -o $WORK/a.a gmod/t/a.go
go tool pack t $WORK/a.a
stdout '__\.PKGDEF'
! stdout '__\.LOGOS'

# A fresh archive imports cleanly through the facts reader.
mkdir $WORK/imp
mkdir $WORK/imp/example.com
mkdir $WORK/imp/example.com/m
cp $WORK/a.a $WORK/imp/example.com/m/a.a
go tool compile -I $WORK/imp -p example.com/m/b -o $WORK/b.a gmod/t/b.go

# A loGo/s archive carries the sidecar; a stale fingerprint fails clean.
# lgo-src is a .lgo package compiled directly (all sources loGo/s).
go tool compile -p example.com/lgo/a -o $WORK/lgo-a.a lgo/a/a.lgo
go tool pack t $WORK/lgo-a.a
stdout '__\.LOGOS'

cd gmod
go run stale.go $WORK/lgo-a.a $WORK/lgo-stale.a
mkdir $WORK/impstale
mkdir $WORK/impstale/example.com
mkdir $WORK/impstale/example.com/lgo
cp $WORK/lgo-stale.a $WORK/impstale/example.com/lgo/a.a
! go tool compile -I $WORK/impstale -p example.com/lgo/b -o $WORK/b-stale.a t/b.lgo
stdout 'logos: stale facts for example\.com/lgo/a \(fingerprint mismatch\)'

# A Go importer reads only __.PKGDEF and is unaffected by the member.
go run impcheck.go $WORK/lgo-a.a
stdout '^importer ok: F 0 1$'
cd ..

-- lgo/go.mod --
module example.com/lgo

go 1.27
-- lgo/a/a.lgo --
package a

type User struct {
	Name string
}

func F() *User {
	return &User{Name: "alice"}
}
-- lgo/b/b.lgo --
package b

import "example.com/lgo/a"

func G() string {
	return a.F().Name
}
-- lgo/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/lgo/b"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println("facts ok: " + b.G())
}
-- gmod/go.mod --
module example.com/g

go 1.27
-- gmod/t/a.go --
package a

type User struct {
	Name string
}

func F() *User {
	return &User{Name: "u"}
}
-- gmod/t/b.go --
package b

import "example.com/m/a"

func G() string {
	return a.F().Name
}
-- gmod/t/b.lgo --
package b

import "example.com/lgo/a"

func G() string {
	return a.F().Name
}
-- gmod/stale.go --
// Command stale copies a compiler archive while flipping one hex digit of
// the __.LOGOS fingerprint line, producing an archive whose facts are stale
// relative to its __.PKGDEF.
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

func fatal(err any) {
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "stale: %v\n", err)
	os.Exit(1)
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 3 {
		fatal("usage: stale in.a out.a")
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	if !bytes.HasPrefix(raw, []byte("!<arch>\n")) {
		fatal("not an archive")
	}
	off := len("!<arch>\n")
	found := false
	for off+60 <= len(raw) {
		hdr := raw[off : off+60]
		if hdr[58] != '`' || hdr[59] != '\n' {
			fatal("corrupt header")
		}
		name := strings.TrimRight(string(hdr[:16]), " ")
		size, err := strconv.ParseUint(strings.TrimRight(string(hdr[48:58]), " "), 10, 64)
		if err != nil {
			fatal(err)
		}
		dataOff := off + 60
		if name == "__.LOGOS" {
			end := dataOff + int(size)
			if end > len(raw) {
				fatal("truncated member")
			}
			i := bytes.Index(raw[dataOff:end], []byte("fingerprint "))
			if i < 0 {
				fatal("no fingerprint line")
			}
			hexOff := dataOff + i + len("fingerprint ")
			if hexOff >= end {
				fatal("empty fingerprint")
			}
			if raw[hexOff] == '0' {
				raw[hexOff] = '1'
			} else {
				raw[hexOff] = '0'
			}
			found = true
			break
		}
		off = dataOff + int(size) + int(size&1)
	}
	if !found {
		fatal("no __.LOGOS member")
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(os.Args[2], raw, 0o666); err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
}
-- gmod/impcheck.go --
// Command impcheck imports a compiler archive through go/importer with a
// file-backed lookup, proving a Go importer reads only __.PKGDEF and is
// unaffected by the __.LOGOS member.
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"go/importer"
	"go/token"
	"go/types"
	"io"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 2 {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "usage: impcheck file.a\n")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	path := os.Args[1]
	imp := importer.ForCompiler(token.NewFileSet(), "gc", func(p string) (io.ReadCloser, error) {
		if p != "example.com/m/a" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown package %s", p)
		}
		return os.Open(path)
	})
	pkg, err := imp.Import("example.com/m/a")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "impcheck: %v\n", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fn, ok := pkg.Scope().Lookup("F").(*types.Func)
	if !ok {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "impcheck: F not a func\n")
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	sig := fn.Type().(*types.Signature)
	fmt.Printf("importer ok: F %d %d\n", sig.Params().Len(), sig.Results().Len())
}
